name: human-in-the-loop-harm-detection-agents
description: Three-agent harmful-content moderation workflow with context and human review loops.

agents.name: DetectionAgent
agents.role: Detects possible harmful content and assigns initial category, confidence, and risk score.

agents.name: ContextAnalysisAgent
agents.role: Analyzes history, sarcasm, relationships, detected language, locale, and community type, then feeds context back to DetectionAgent or PolicyAgent.

agents.name: PolicyAgent
agents.role: Decides allow, warn, remove, or suspend, and can request more context before final recommendation.
